title: The Secret of the Vizjerei
subtitle: Lut Gholein · Tombs of Tal Rasha · Arcane Sanctuary

questions.prompt: What is the Act II town called?
questions.explanation: Lut Gholein, the largest city in the game, is a sunbaked trading port on the edge of the Twin Seas.

questions.prompt: Duriel, slain in the tomb beneath the desert, bears which title?
questions.explanation: Duriel, Act II's end boss, is known as the Lord of Pain.
Radament lurks on the third level of the Sewers beneath Lut Gholein.

questions.prompt: Radament is which type of monster?
questions.explanation: Radament is a Super Unique Greater Mummy who heals and resurrects the undead around him.

questions.prompt: The Horadric Cube is recovered from a chest in which dungeon?
questions.explanation: The Cube sits in a chest on the third level of the Halls of the Dead.

questions.prompt: How many inventory spaces does the Horadric Cube occupy?
questions.explanation: The Cube occupies 12 spaces (4 wide by 3 tall).

questions.prompt: The Summoner is confronted in which area?
questions.explanation: The Summoner must be slain in the Arcane Sanctuary to unlock the Canyon of the Magi.

questions.prompt: Which trio names the Sorceress's three skill trees?
questions.explanation: The Sorceress masters Fire, Cold, and Lightning spells.

questions.prompt: Defeating The Summoner grants access to what?
questions.explanation: Killing the Summoner opens the way to the Canyon of the Magi, where the true tomb of Tal Rasha awaits.

questions.prompt: Which of these is NOT an Act II surface area?
questions.explanation: Frozen Tundra belongs to Act V. Act II's sand-blown sweep runs Rocky Waste, Dry Hills, Far Oasis, Lost City, Valley of Snakes.

questions.prompt: Which set of modifiers describes The Summoner?
choices: Extra Strong, Extra Fast, resistant to Fire/Cold/Lightning
questions.explanation: The Summoner is Extra Strong, Extra Fast, and resistant to all three elements: Fire, Cold, and Lightning.
